verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow is pulled away from the headline and stuck above the button. The can is shrunk to an unreadable speck jammed against the Shop Sale button, and the legal text is crammed against the right edge. B keeps the eyebrow-above-headline order and a recognisable can, and the legal text sits under the CTA. Its flaws are a body line squeezed so tight that it reads 'mixedcase', a headline and CTA that are too small, and a weak, scattered middle with uneven gaps.
